lines: Active rows: selected supplied-save classes C009, C013, C028, C034 and D01: static contracts and both-copy structural qualification.

Opaque leaf types (F-900) are ordered 4-B parts, no count/tail: both 12-B native serializers transfer 3, one 16-B transfers 4; the other 16-B is a false stub and C028 child N01, whose reflected path transfers 4 (F-369)
